en.title: Auditing Anonymous AI Models: A Four-Stage Protocol for Black-Box Identity Verification
en.hook: Discover a four-stage black-box identity verification protocol to audit stealth-released anonymous frontier AI models.
key_takeaways: Addressing the wave of stealth-released anonymous models in 2025-2026
Importance of identity verification for data-handling terms and support
Systematic four-stage auditing protocol for black-box environments

黑盒环境下的系统化四阶段审计协议
